name: @apsis-io/magicseam
description: Magic-seam (ADR-0028) provider/consumer for a genuinely non-WASM TypeScript program (Node.js/Bun) - the revived MSK1 protocol (magicseam.ts) or the mTLS QUIC transport (quic.ts, ADR-0043), mirroring go/magicseam.
